Tomato___healthy.symptoms: Foliage exhibits vigorous deep green coloration with uniform texture and no necrotic lesions or chlorosis.
Tomato___healthy.treatment: Maintain balanced N-P-K fertilization, ensure drip irrigation at the base to avoid leaf dampness, and scout weekly for early pest vectors.
Tomato___healthy.prevention: Rotate crops every 2-3 seasons with non-solanaceous crops.
Tomato___healthy.source: FAO / University of Florida Agricultural Extension

Tomato___Early_blight.symptoms: Dark brown to black necrotic spots with concentric rings ('bullseye' target pattern) starting on older lower foliage.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicides (e.g. Copper Hydroxide) or Chlorothalonil / Mancozeb. Prune lower affected leaves to arrest upward spore splash.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Ensure wide plant spacing for airflow, mulch around base to prevent soil splash, and avoid overhead sprinkler watering.

Tomato___Late_blight.symptoms: Rapidly expanding water-soaked greasy gray-green lesions with white fungal-like sporulation on the leaf underside under high humidity.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Aggressively remove and bag infected foliage immediately. Treat unaffected rows with systemic phosphonates or metalaxyl/mancozeb fungicides.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified disease-free transplants and blight-resistant cultivars. Avoid planting near potato crops.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Small circular greasy water-soaked spots that darken with yellow halos; severe infection causes leaf drop and sunburn on fruit.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply fixed copper bactericides combined with mancozeb; spray early in the morning so foliage dries quickly.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified pathogen-free seeds; treat seeds in hot water (50°C for 25 min) prior to sowing.

Potato___Early_blight.symptoms: Concentric dark brown angular lesions bounded by leaf veins; premature senescence of potato foliage.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Foliar applications of azoxystrobin, chlorothalonil, or difenoconazole as soon as lower leaves exhibit lesions.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Maintain adequate nitrogen and potassium levels; eliminate wild nightshade weed hosts.

Potato___Late_blight.symptoms: Dark blotches on leaf tips and margins; devastating rapid blighting during cool damp periods.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Systemic fungicides (e.g. Cymoxanil, Propamocarb); prompt rogueing and destruction of infected tuber haulms.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Strictly use certified seed tubers; destroy cull piles.

Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.symptoms: Water-soaked dark lesions on leaves, leading to severe defoliation and compromised yield.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Copper-mancozeb tank mix sprays; streptomycin in seedbeds where legally permitted.
Pepper__bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use resistant seed hybrids (e.g. races 1-5 resistant varieties).

Pepper__bell___healthy.symptoms: Uniform glossy green foliage without spotting or wilting.
Pepper__bell___healthy.treatment: Standard nutrient management and drip irrigation.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.symptoms: Cinnamon-brown powdery pustules on both upper and lower leaf surfaces.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.treatment: Foliar strobilurin or triazole fungicides if rust appears before tasseling on susceptible hybrids.

Apple___Apple_scab.symptoms: Olive-green to velvety dark brown lesions on leaves and fruit, causing leaf distortion and premature leaf drop.
Apple___Apple_scab.treatment: Apply protective fungicides (Captan, Mancozeb) or post-infection sterol inhibitors (Myclobutanil).
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Shred fallen leaves or apply urea in late autumn to accelerate leaf decomposition and destroy overwintering ascospores.

default.symptoms: Foliar pathology identified by deep learning classifier.
default.treatment: Isolate affected specimens, ensure proper drainage, and collect physical samples for testing at an agricultural extension center.
default.prevention: Practice strict crop rotation, sanitize pruning shears with 70% alcohol, and maintain weed control.
